verdict.rationale: MoonPay has an extensive API/SDK reference (endpoints, methods, OpenAPI codegen) and even an MCP server for AI agents to search/retrieve docs content, plus a clone-able demo-integrations repo — but there is no evidence of an in-browser 'try it now' / runnable example console like Swagger UI or Stripe's API explorer, and a probe for a public openapi.json spec returned 404s at standard paths. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it/run-in-browser feature, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec endpoint, and independent confirmation that examples are actually executable rather than just code snippets.
